flows.title: Inline content and revision
steps: Open a page and invoke slash menu
Choose Generate and describe content
Review draft in place
Accept, request revision, or undo
flows.description: Selection-based toolbar, block handle, inline generator and review
flows.limitations: Documented text; exact error/focus/animation not observed

flows.title: Interactive visualization inside a page
steps: Invoke Visualize with a request
Choose a starting point such as app, widget, screen or diagram
Review generated result and test controls
Request changes using adjacent chat
flows.description: Generated visualization is a different output from a native page block; persistence must be checked separately
flows.limitations: Official guide; not a native template inventory

flows.title: Child page versus reference
steps: Open parent page
Choose Page to create a child, or Link to page to reference an existing page
Name new child or select target
Navigate the related content
flows.description: Child containment differs from reference; drag handle can move an entire heading section
flows.limitations: Official guide; exact navigation history and deletion restoration untested

flows.title: Collaborative whiteboard workflow
steps: Request a board or choose the Whiteboards tile
Arrange shapes, arrows and sections with collaborators
Optionally follow a teammate
Transform to a document/deck or export PNG
flows.description: Whiteboard beta; external invite policy; connected-app context not used on board per guide
flows.limitations: Official help; association with generic canvas is contextual, not same editor

flows.title: Collaborative spreadsheet workflow
steps: Start blank or describe a sheet
Edit cells with Claude and collaborators
Inspect outlined changed cells and formulas
Use version history or export XLSX
flows.description: Tabs, formulas, conditional formatting, dropdowns, checkboxes and charts; no connected-app live data at launch
flows.limitations: Official help; visual selection and history behavior not tested

flows.title: Page creation, reading and update
steps: Ask Bot to create page
Open title card in chat
Use adjacent page-specific chat to request revision
Earlier card indicates updated version; reopen latest
flows.description: Desktop page dominates window; mobile closes back to chat. Reader filters/switches alter view only and do not save

flows.title: Library discovery and pinning
steps: Open Bot profile/details and Library
Browse date groups (five items at first) or use search
Show more or open item
Use overflow to pin/unpin; page owner can share
flows.description: Library excludes user uploads and Cloud Agent returned files per guide; desktop shortcut Cmd/Ctrl+K
flows.limitations: Official help; actual visual grouping and pin order untested

flows.title: Page sharing and access failure
steps: Open page sharing settings
Choose permitted audience
Copy link or narrow access
If access update fails, retry
flows.description: Private by default; public link allows reading and controls, but only Bot edits content; unavailable options explain why
flows.limitations: Official help; no live access matrix tested

flows.title: Canvas application editing and debugging
steps: Open app in Canvas
Switch to Code to edit or request a change
Inspect preview console and recent changes
Use Select & ask for scoped revision
flows.description: Edits auto-save; version controls documented for docs; preview errors and logs available

flows.title: Canvas sharing and app information review
steps: Open Share & export
Choose Share
Review app information about shared data, AI features and session persistence
Copy public link if appropriate
flows.description: Anyone with public link may view/edit associated shared data; distinguish app data from document content
flows.limitations: Official help; live security behavior not tested

flows.title: Flashcard generation and review loop
steps: Select sources and Studio Flashcards or customization pencil
Choose difficulty/prompt; generation runs in background
Study with Explain, previous/next, known/missed controls
Review results; retry same, all, or missed cards
flows.description: Progress resumes; shuffle, delete card, restart, fullscreen and CSV where allowed. Edit access required to generate/delete study aid
flows.limitations: Official help; correct/incorrect visual design and actual state persistence untested

flows.title: Quiz generation and review loop
steps: Choose Quiz in Studio, customize if needed
Wait while continuing other work
Answer and use Hint/Explain or navigate questions
Review or retake at end
flows.description: Fullscreen and previous/next; no claim of exact submit-button behavior or answer timing
flows.limitations: Official help; feedback and score states need screenshots
